ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous region covering the central peduncle attachment and inner lobes; high-intensity pixels form broad bands along the lateral trailing edges and tips with a high-degree of mottling in transitional zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad, shallow V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire boundary; pixel amplitude for peaks varies between 8 to 15 pixels relative to the local edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile on both lobes, tapering into sharp, slightly hooked distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white textured clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the high-intensity white region of the left lobe's trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy scarring and possible biological encrustations concentrated at the outermost tips of both flukes.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, dark circular pigmentation spots (freckles) scattered within the high-intensity white regions on the lateral sections of both lobes.
